title: Inside JetBrains—the company reshaping how the world writes code
summary: JetBrains is integrating GPT-5 across its coding tools, helping millions of developers design, reason, and build software faster.
body: JetBrains is integrating GPT-5 across its coding tools, helping millions of developers design, reason, and build software faster.
summaryZh: JetBrains宣布将GPT-5集成至其开发工具链中，旨在提升开发者的代码设计、逻辑推理及软件构建效率。此次合作标志着大模型在专业开发环境中的深度应用，通过增强AI辅助编程能力，进一步改变软件开发流程。

aiReview.reasonZh: 涉及GPT-5在主流开发工具中的集成，反映了模型在软件工程领域的实际应用趋势。
